notes: Tereza Maelo's arms stall, the Tidemarket, Wendmouth (story bible §5.13; mw-e40.31, part of mw-e40.10): the best steel in the region from a retired duellist who pretends not to miss using it. A tempered knife, staves, bucklers and a kite shield, a brigandine and a stamina tonic (spears, maces and halberds stay out of the shops until the economy pass, tests/integration/shop-row-content.test.ts). Her dialogue opens the window (`tereza.shop-requested`). Prices sit at the economy doc's default band: markup 1.3 (band 1.1-1.5) and buy rate 0.4 (band 0.3-0.6); weapons and shields are her specialties (bonus at the default 1.2). The under-the-counter tier (a fine longsword, a kettle helm, tempered mail) is hidden until the player has beaten her in a duel or an honest Tidefair winner has earned her regard (`tereza.under-counter`, `tidefair.regarded`; AC-3 of mw-e40.10), and appears at the next restock. 500 gold in the till, refilling 100 a day. Item values are catalogue placeholders the balance pass will move. Still to do under mw-e40.10: the Saltmarch stock (curved sabres, harpoon-spears, lacquered shields, sharkskin brigandine) waits on the approved item art, and the exotic arrows, spice stall and the foreign book cart are their own content.
